name: Surveyor 6
intro: After landing I will do something no one has done: fire my engines and HOP to a new spot!
Just three metres, but hey, the first lift-off from the Moon.
Pick where I land first, in the middle of the Moon's near side.
briefing: We are heading for Sinus Medii, the Bay in the Middle.
Choose a site where I will have daylight for my hop.
fact: Surveyor 6 made the first lift-off from the Moon: a 3-metre hop, a rehearsal for Apollo.
